Learning, Design and Technology Expo 2011

Elijah Meeks

Originally published at Digital Humanities Specialist. This edition preserves the original text and historical context.

Tomorrow is the public exhibition of the final projects for the Learning, Design and Technology program here at Stanford.  I’ve been asked to be one of the reviewers of the projects, which include learning games, map-based teaching tools, museum aids and at least one mobile app designed to increase the awareness and creation of poetry.
